how.description: How the person proved who they are: the sign-in connector, or recovery.

class.description: The class of the session the sign-in opens: interactive for a person at a browser, agent for software that keeps its own refresh token and works in the background. Absent on a refusal and on a sign-in to the console.

deadline.description: The latest the session the sign-in opens may live, however often it is refreshed: auth_time plus its class's absolute limit, shortened by its resource's.
